title: A model that works with text
summary: A large language model, or LLM, uses learned numbers to predict pieces of text. It can help draft and transform text, but its output can still be mistaken.
introduction: A large language model, or LLM, uses learned numbers to predict pieces of text. It can help draft and transform text, but its output can still be mistaken. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: These are introductory concept lessons. Python snippets use only Python 3 in a separate environment. No real model is loaded and no remote API is called.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Large Language Models. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.
